text: Harbour City führte zur Halbzeit 2:0 dank der Treffer von Elias Okafor und Marek Barros, die beide aus Chancen mit eher niedriger Trefferwahrscheinlichkeit entstanden (xG 0,111 und 0,009) [#905] [#975]. Marek Barros glänzte als Spieler des Spiels mit 1 Tor, 2 Vorlagen und 9 abgefangenen Bällen bei einer Laufleistung von fast 15 km [#1906]. Seabrook Town hatte im ersten Durchgang zwar mehr Ballbesitz, kam aber erst nach der Halbzeit durch eine starke Umstellung richtig ins Spiel und erhöhte die Pressingintensität und Direktheit, was zu 4 Toren führte [#1361]. Besonders Kian Romano erzielte in der Nachspielzeit zwei Tore mit guten Chancenwerten (xG 0,609 und 0,959) und drehte so das Spiel zu Gunsten von Seabrook Town [#1882] [#1906]. Der Platzverweis gegen Harbour City kurz vor der Pause könnte den Umschwung begünstigt haben [#871].

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in de

- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals with a combined xG of 2.034, including two late goals by Kian Romano in added time with xG 0.609 and 0.959, overturning a 2-0 deficit [#1882, #1906].
- Harbour City led 2-0 at halftime with goals from Elias Okafor (xG 0.111) and Marek Barros (xG 0.009) but Seabrook Town dominated the second half with 4 goals [#905, #975].
- Marek Barros of Harbour City was man of the match: scored 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, 4 tackles, 5 key passes, with a rating of 9.8 and covered 14.74 km [#1906].
- Harbour City had fewer shots (10 vs 22), shots on target (5 vs 9), and a lower expected goals (1.0 vs 3.48) than Seabrook Town, reflecting Seabrook's offensive dominance [team_stats].
- A red card to Joon Whitfield of Harbour City at 43' may have influenced the second half momentum, as Seabrook Town increased pressing and directness after 65' [#871, #1361].

- Harbour City scored their first goal through patient build-up involving 17 passes over 56.7 seconds, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and "patient short passing" style. The goal came from a through ball assist by Marek Barros, showing their methodical approach to breaking down defenses [904,905].
- Marek Barros’ second goal came from a cross following a corner, indicating the use of set pieces in Harbour City's tactical approach, which provided opportunities even if their primary style was patient passing [973,975].
- Seabrook Town’s response was quicker, with Tariq Marlowe scoring immediately after regaining possession, indicating a pressing trap or quick transition to exploit turnover moments. This fits Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 formation emphasizing wide, crossing play and attacking quickly after regains [1103,1104].
- Seabrook Town made a tactical adjustment at 65', increasing press intensity, directness, and line height to chase the game, which led to more direct attacking chances and eventually their comeback goals. This tactical switch reflects a shift from a controlled possession style to a higher pressing and direct approach, capitalizing on their wide crossing play inherent in the 3-4-3 formation [1361].
- The late goals by Seabrook Town, including a quick counter-attack goal by Kian Romano from a regain, show effective exploitation of turnovers and direct play, consistent with their tactical change to a higher press and more direct style in the final phase of the match [1881,1882].
- Harbour City’s late tactical change to press higher and play more direct was a reaction to trailing, but Seabrook’s earlier adjustment and better execution of their wide crossing and pressing style overwhelmed Harbour City in the match’s decisive moments [1884].
